artifacts.summary: Root cause: orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh never writes state.json status='partial' on a partial dispatch outcome, so orchestrate-triage-classify.sh's already-existing partial+blockers->needs_human routing rule never fires (dead code). Fix: call the already-wired postflight:partial transition unconditionally on dispatch_status=partial; this alone satisfies redispatch-stop with zero orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh changes. Rejects resolving to status=blocked (falls into dependency-discharge 'skip' bucket, silent). Recommends widening the blocker-research aux-signal gate, and adding blocked-vs-partial guidance to the shared context/contracts/wrap-up.md contract rather than duplicating across ~60 implementer agent files.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's /orchestrate multi-task engine, orchestrate-triage-classify.sh's partial-status routing rows (continuation->implement, blockers-no-continuation->needs_human) are keyed on state.json's status field literally being "partial". orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's partial|failed|blocked case arm historically never wrote that status transition (comment: "remains at its current in-flight status"), even though update-task-status.sh already had a fully wired, schema-validated postflight:partial transition. Any defect where a partial/blocked dispatch outcome seems to be "ignored" by routing should first check whether the postflight status-write is actually happening, before assuming the routing table itself is wrong -- the table is often already correct and just unreachable.

In orchestrate-triage-classify.sh, status="blocked" routing is overloaded with dependency-graph discharge semantics: a blocked task with empty dependencies[] routes to a SILENT "skip" in the multi-task engine (no out_blocked_rows entry, invisible to the user). Never resolve a non-dependency (e.g. external/environmental) blocker to status="blocked" expecting visible escalation -- use status="partial" with a populated blockers[] instead, which always routes to the visible "needs_human" bucket regardless of dependencies[].
